exact_manuscript_sentence: In materials fixed-budget public-label replay, the ALIGNN-FF K=300 request prevented 64.25 unstable follow-ups on average while keeping the PARC FTR at 0.087.
In materials fixed-budget public-label replay, the ALIGNN-FF K=500 request prevented 158.30 unstable follow-ups on average while keeping the PARC FTR at 0.048.
At the ALIGNN-FF K=300 and K=500 budgets, PARC reduced released unstable materials relative to the raw top-K follow-up queue while returning a smaller certified queue.
In CTC, PARC released sequence-disjoint learned cell-link candidates at alpha=0.10 with 20/20 non-empty seeds and zero held-out false-link fraction.
